items.title: Do humans really have a ‘lizard brain’ lurking beneath our rational minds?
items.summary: It’s a powerful analogy that captured the popular imagination, but the biological reality is quite different Humans have a cognitive quirk for the number three. Think of the many stories that use it, from The Three Little Pigs to Goldilocks and the Three Bears and The Three Musketeers. Public information and political campaigns use it for impact and ease of recall (“Stop, look and listen”; “See it. Say it. Sorted”; “Reduce, reuse, recycle”). And then there are psychological or philosophical frameworks: Freud with his id, ego and superego; Plato’s three parts of the human soul; the Holy Trinity. Well, it turns out neuroscience isn’t immune from tri-mania. In 1959 Paul D MacLean set out a new way of thinking about the evolution and function of the brain, which he christened the “triune” – three-in-one – model. It quickly became one of best known and most enduring concepts in human biology. articles.snippet: 한미일 외교당국이 3일 북한의 탄도미사일 발사와 관련해 유선협의를 갖고 향후 대응 방안을 논의했다. 외교부에 따르면 이날 백용진 외교부 한반도정책국장은 데이비드 윌레졸 미국 국무부 한일 담당 부차관보, 아리요시 다카시 일본 외무성 아시아대양주국 심의관과 유선협의를 통해 관련 정보 등을 공유했다.외교부는 한미일 외교당국 간에는 북한의 탄도미사일 발사 때마다 관련 정보 및 상황 평가를 신속하게 공유하는 채널을 운영하고 있다.앞서 북한은 이날 오전 6시30분께 원산 일대에서 동해상으로 탄도미사일 1발을 발사했다. 합참은 포착된 북한의 미사일은 700㎞ 이상을 비행한 것으로 분석했다.이에 대해 김여정 북한 노동당 총무부장은 같은 날 조선중앙통신을 통한 발표문에서 “오늘 새벽 우리 나라 동해상으로 전략무기발사훈련이 진행되었다”며 “훈련에는 중거리전략미사일이 사용되었다”고 밝혔다. 이번 훈련에 김정은 국무위원장이 직접 참관한 사실도 공개했다.[서울=뉴시스]

The anger is at the sheer absurdity of this, and the stories of of sexual violence and harassment I read about every day. I am not the only one. articles.title: Suicide by plane or terrorism? Speculation over motive in flight 1073 attack
articles.snippet: Experts sceptical flydubai co-pilot’s only motivation was to end his own life and say key question is means of radicalisation At about 9.30 on Wednesday morning local time, Tali Manes was taking her six-year-old daughter, Nina, to the toilet on the regular flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv when she heard a series of heavy blows against the cockpit door. Manes, an Israeli bank executive, immediately told a flight attendant seated nearby that something was wrong. When he did not react, she shouted at him: “Something is happening in there!” Seconds later, the man “simply went to the [cockpit] door and opened it”, Manes told Israel’s Channel 12 TV.
